runs.note: 2026-09-04 full rebuild over 137 semantic chunks + AST. Per-chunk token counts were NOT captured back into the chunk JSONs, so this run contributes 0 to the totals rather than a fabricated figure. Actual cost was ~137 subagents averaging roughly 60k-180k tokens each; treat the all-time totals below as a floor, not a measurement.
input_tokens is the COMBINED subagent total (22 chunks); the harness reports one subagent_tokens figure, not an input/output split, so output_tokens is 0 rather than a fabricated share.

runs.combined_subagent_tokens_note: Chunks were banked to the extraction cache rather than having usage written back into chunk JSON, so no input/output split exists for this run. combined_subagent_tokens is the sum of reported subagent usage over 131 chunk runs (125 chunks plus 6 re-runs after a weekly-limit interruption); the six agents killed by that limit reported no usage, so this figure is a floor. input_tokens/output_tokens are 0 because the split is unknown, not because the run was free.
